narrator_hint: seventh-storyteller / ending routes: several characters; work out the speaker from context

rows.en:
...A pitch-black void stretched out around me.
Even with my eyes open...
Even with my eyes closed...
There was nothing before me but darkness...
What on earth happened?
My head was throbbing...
Did I hit it on something?
Hmm, I can't really remember.{p}

It was strangely quiet. What had happened to everyone?
I felt like I'd heard Shindo scream just before I passed out...
I raised my head and slowly looked around.
Just as I thought, I was wrapped in darkness and couldn't see a thing.
But somewhere beyond that darkness, I sensed someone faintly moving.{p}

...Someone's there!
The moment I thought that...
"You're awake?"
Suddenly, I heard a man's voice.
A familiar, blunt tone...
This was...{p}

...It was Shindo's voice!
I couldn't see him, but Shindo was definitely there.
"Shindo, where are we?
It's so dark I can't see anything.
How long was I unconscious?
And...
It's awfully quiet. Are we the only ones here?
What about the others...?"{p}

"Whoa, whoa...
If you hit me with that many questions at once, how am I supposed to know which one to answer first?
Calm down a little and talk slower."
...Had I bombarded him with questions?
Yeah, I guess I had.
Shindo was right. I'd better calm down a bit.
I just had to calm down and ask one question at a time.{p}But what should I ask first...?
Where are we...?
What time is it now...?
What about the others...?

"Where are we?"
".................."
...No answer.
Maybe Shindo didn't know either.
Then I'd ask about something else.{p}

"Um...
What time do you think it is now?"
"...Beats me.
I don't know the exact time either.
When the lights in the room went out, somebody hit me on the back of the head and I blacked out.
I wonder how much time's gone by since then..."
...Oh, so the same thing had happened to Shindo as to me.
In this darkness I couldn't even see my watch...
There was no telling what time it was.
I'd better ask about something else.{p}

"...What do you think happened to the others?"
That's right.
When the power went out, Arai and Kazama were there, and Iwashita and Hosoda...
Fukuzawa was there too.
What happened to everyone?
Are they here...?
Or not...?
"I don't know what happened to the others.
When I came to, you were the only one I could see."
Shindo's voice sounded terribly dejected, and it was trembling faintly.
It seemed I'd asked something I shouldn't have.
Maybe I should change the subject and ask something else...{p}

...But even if I asked something else, what was I supposed to ask?
While I was agonizing over it...
"...Sorry, {a}."
Shindo murmured.
What had come over him all of a sudden?
"Looks like because of me, I've dragged you into something terrible too."
"Something terrible...?"
"Yeah...
Let's go back to the story I told earlier.
I said that in my dream I killed a man, right?{p}

Truth is...
Among the people who got together here today, there was someone who looked exactly like that man.
I don't know what the connection is between that one and the man in my dream.
Maybe it's the same person, maybe it's family.
All I know is that whoever it is holds a grudge against me and wants to avenge the man from my dream..."{p}

...Could something like that really happen?
I mean, that was all just a story about a dream, wasn't it?
To think someone would seriously plan to avenge a person who was killed in a dream...
Could it be that I'm...
being made fun of by Shindo?{p}"What's wrong, {a}?
You look so surprised...
You can't believe a story like this?"
I believe you
I can't believe it

"I see, so you believe me.
...Thanks."
Shindo's voice was as blunt as ever, but there was a warmth in it that somehow put me at ease.
He must be someone I can rely on...
"{a}...
Earlier, you asked me where we were, right?
I couldn't answer that question.
The reason is......"
Suddenly Shindo broke off.
At that very moment...{p}

With a booming BOOOOM, the ground rumbled and the whole space shook violently.
An earthquake...★
No, that wasn't it.
That wasn't how an earthquake shakes.
"...That was fast.
So they've already started to move..."{p}

Shindo murmured, as if talking to himself.
Who did he mean by 'they'...?
...He must mean the person out for revenge on Shindo★
Was that rumbling just now that person's doing...?
"{a}...
We're out of time, so I'll make this quick.
This is the newspaper club room.
But it's not the real newspaper club.{p}

This is a space that was born where the school from my dream and the real school crossed over.
To put it simply, we've been possessed by their curse, school and all.
That rumbling just now was probably something like their signal that the fight has started.
Your life might not be safe for much longer either."{p}

...Honestly, Shindo!
I wish he wouldn't say such frightening things so casually.
It only makes me more anxious about what's going to happen next.
Whether or not he noticed how jumpy I was...
Shindo went on.{p}

"Truth is...
{a}, I've got a favor to ask you."
He sounded perfectly calm...
Wasn't Shindo afraid of the situation we were in...?{p}"It's a really serious favor.
Will you hear me out...?"
Answer yes
Answer no

"All right, then here it is.
What I'm asking you is...
{a}...
Get out of here, on your own, fast.
That's all."
"On my own...?"
"That's right.
...Listen.
I'm the one they're after, nobody else.
So if you're on your own, you should be able to get away without them coming after you.
For all we know, the others got away a long time ago.
Anyway, this place is dangerous.
Hurry up and get out!"{p}

"...But what about you, Shindo?"
"Don't worry about me.
Believe it or not, I've got pretty good reflexes.
Let's see...
The only space they can control is inside the school.
...Once you're outside the school gate, you'll be fine.{p}Listen, we'll both get out safe and meet up there.
...You can do that, right?"
I can
I can't

"Good!
Now hurry up and go!"{p}

At that moment, a space appeared in the darkness, as if a square had been cut out of it.
...A door!
Beyond that space, I could see the hallway.
"Listen, {a}.
Be careful.
This place is real, and yet it isn't.
It's a very unstable space.
Be careful...
and run without hesitating.
Got it...!"
A warm hand gave my back a light push...
...Shindo?{p}

I turned around, but there was nothing behind me but darkness.
"Hurry...!"
"Y-yes!"
Urged on by that voice, I stepped out into the hallway.{p}

First, I have to get out of the building...
Normally, the way in and out would be the front entrance, but...
I could also use the fire escape.{p}...Which way should I go?
Head for the front entrance
Use the fire escape
What should I do...

The way in and out of the building is the front entrance, of course!
From there I can go out into the schoolyard first and then run for the school gate.{p}

It'll be fine.
To get to the front entrance, all I had to do was go to the end of the hallway in front of me and then down the stairs.
It wasn't a route I could get lost on, and it wasn't far, either.
I took one deep breath and started walking down the empty hallway.

Only my footsteps echoed through the silent hallway.
This was a hallway I walked all the time, so why did it feel longer than usual? Because this was a cursed space?
The smooth floor felt as if it were sticking to the soles of my indoor shoes.
Dragging my feet with a slap, slap, I finally reached the end of the hallway.{p}

...Now I just had to go down the stairs...
The moment I thought that and took a step forward...
With a thump, something slammed into my back.{p}

"Eek!"
I lost my balance, and my body was flung out into the air.
The hard floor of the landing was rushing up at me.

Instead, I felt as though something soft, like feathers, had gently wrapped around me.{p}.........What?
What just happened...?
Open my eyes
Don't open my eyes
What should I do...

I didn't open my eyes.
I mustn't open my eyes...
That's what I felt.
Then the feathery sensation wrapped around me vanished, and in its place I felt something cold and hard through the soles of my indoor shoes.
.........?{p}

When I slowly opened my eyes, I was standing on the landing.
...I was sure I'd fallen.
But I didn't hurt anywhere.
They say you're less likely to get hurt if you fall in a natural position than if you twist your body unnaturally...
Even so, I should have hit something somewhere.
And yet...{p}

I remembered that soft sensation from before.
It had felt warm, somehow...
Suddenly, someone's face flitted across my mind.
Who was that...?
But I had no time to think about that.{p}

Anyway, getting away came first right now.
I had to get outside, fast.
I pulled myself together and started down the stairs.
The hot, muggy, clammy air clung to me.
Through that heavy air, I went down one careful step at a time.{p}

I walked past the bulletin board, slipped by the shoe lockers, and put my hand on the front entrance door.
Then I pushed the door hard.{p}

I saw the empty schoolyard.
Cold outside air rushed in.
The breeze was a little damp, but right now it felt wonderful to me.
Still in my indoor shoes, I stepped out into the schoolyard.{p}

Step by step, the school gate drew closer.
...Had Shindo managed to get away safely?
I walked on, thinking about that...
...There was no one at the school gate.
He isn't here yet.
So I got here first.
That's fine. I just have to wait.
I'll wait, and wait, and wait...
Shindo, please hurry......
Isn't he here yet......?
Isn't he here yet......?
Isn't he here yet......?{p}

rows.en:
....................Oh!
Someone was walking over from the school building.
Oh, here comes another one...
But... they were both girls.
So it wasn't Shindo.
.........How disappointing.

"Hey, hey, did you know?
There's a rumor that this school gate is haunted."
"Ehh? What's that about?"
The two girls chattered away as they walked right past me.
"A while back, there was a girl from the newspaper club who fell down the stairs in the new school building and died.
People say it might be her ghost."
"If she died in the new school building, why would she show up at the school gate?"

.........I wonder how many people have walked through this gate since then.
But Shindo never comes.
"Rumor has it she's waiting for someone."
"Huh..."
That's right...
I'm waiting.
Because I promised.
I promised I'd wait for him outside the school gate.{p}So I'm waiting.
Ever since that day, on and on and on..................{p}
I opened the door once more.{p}

..........And yet another door.
Ugh!
Just how many doors are there?
Stubbornly keep opening doors
Give up and think of another way

I decided to give up and look for another way.
Luckily, this was the first floor...
I could just go into some classroom and slip out through a window.
I headed for the classroom closest to the front entrance.{p}

The classroom was dim and utterly silent.
I went in nervously and hurried over to the window.
...Okay, this is fine.
It looks like I can get outside through this window...
I quietly reached for the lock.

Click...
The lock came undone with a small sound.
Just then...
"{a}...
Are you planning to go out that way?"
I jumped when someone suddenly spoke to me.
I hadn't sensed anyone there...
Heart pounding, I turned toward the voice.
...And there stood...{p}

"Arai..."
When did he show up?
Before I came in?
...Or after?
Either way, I hadn't noticed him there at all.
"{a}.
I know escaping is difficult, but you'd better not try something like climbing out a window.
If you go out that way and get hurt, don't come crying to me.
Well...
If you're absolutely set on going out that window, I won't stop you...{p}

But if you can't find any other way out, I'll show you the way.
To my very own secret exit........."
I want to go out the window
Have him show me the exit

I walked down a long hallway that went on and on.
I just kept walking down the endless, long, long hallway.
...There couldn't be a hallway this long.
But this was a cursed space, so anything could happen...
Even so, it felt like the whole space was getting darker.{p}

"{a}...
We'll be there soon.
Ah, but my, what a dark hallway this is.
Do you know why this place is so dark?{p}

And then, when everything around us had gone completely pitch-black...
"Here we are."
...he said, turning back to me.
It was too dark to see well, but there seemed to be a small door in the wall behind Arai.
"Now then, {a}.
If you open this door, you'll be able to get outside."
When I moved closer for a good look, there really was a door there.
A little door, just big enough for one child to pass through.
"Thank you."
"Not at all. There's no need to thank me."
With that, Arai vanished into the blackness of the dark hallway.{p}

I couldn't shake an eerie feeling, but I turned to face the door, reached out, and gently took hold of the knob.
............And then...
The door swung open without a sound.
And on the other side......{p}

I saw the empty schoolyard.
Cold outside air rushed in.
The wind was a little damp, but right now it felt wonderful to me.
...Still, I felt like I'd seen this view somewhere before.
Well, I'm at school, so of course it looks familiar, but...
Still in my indoor shoes, I stepped out into the schoolyard.
Then I casually glanced back, and I was startled.{p}

This is... the front entrance!
...No wonder the view looked so familiar.
But...
Then where on earth had Arai and I been walking all that time, and how?
And that little door I squeezed through...?
There's just too much I don't understand......{p}

...But right now, what matters is keeping my promise to Shindo.
I have to get outside the school gate, fast...{p}

"No.
Thank you for the offer, but I'd like to go out this window."
I felt bad about it, but I turned him down anyway.
...I just don't feel comfortable around Arai.{p}

"I see...
That's a shame."{p}

...I'm sorry.
Apologizing to Arai deep in my heart, I opened the window and climbed up onto the sill.
It isn't very high, so it's a total piece of cake.
"Well then, Arai.
Goodbye."
I gave him a little wave and hopped lightly down outside.
Hee hee, a perfect landing!
See? There was nothing to worry about, no chance of getting hurt.
And Arai, worrying about me with that desperate look on his face...
I couldn't hold back the laughter welling up inside me.{p}
At that moment, I suddenly felt a rush of air from above...{p}

A sharp blow struck my head.
The scene before my eyes warped wildly, and I crumpled to the ground like a doll.
...Heavy.
Something is on top of my body.
What is this thing pressing down on me...?{p}

Drip... drip... Something lukewarm came trickling down.
This is blood...★
Then...
Then...
The thing on top of me is...☆{p}

"See? That's why I told you.
That window is dangerous, because things often fall from up there..."
I heard Arai's voice, strangely delighted.
"{a}, are you all right?
Your head...
It's split wide open.
The blood is just gushing out...
...You don't look very all right, I'm afraid.
That's what you get for ignoring other people's advice.
Let's be more careful next time, shall we?
...That is, if there is a next time...
Isn't that right, {a}...?{p}Oh?
Have you lost consciousness already?
Poor thing...
Just as I thought, there was no next time."{p}

I'm not giving up yet!
I put my hand on the door and pushed it with all my strength.{p}
Darkness spread out before me.{p}

This is...
Could it be the newspaper club room, where I started?
Have I...
Have I come all the way back to square one?
As I stood there at a loss, a voice came out of the darkness.
"{a}...?"
Shindo's voice. How I'd missed it.
"Why'd you come back?
I told you to run, didn't I...?"
"Yes...
I ran as hard as I could, but before I knew it, I'd ended up back here..."{p}

"I see...
So it didn't work..."
"But what about you, Shindo? Didn't you get away?
You said we'd meet up at the school gate...
So why are you here......?"
"Heh...
Yeah, I did say that.
...I couldn't get away either."
Shindo's voice was growing weaker and weaker.
Was he hurt somewhere?{p}

"Um...
Shindo...?"
"Hey, {a}...
I knew from the very start that I was the one guy who'd never get out.
So I figured at least you could make it, but...
...That didn't work out either.
So, y'know...
You might as well stay here with me.
Everybody else is here too, after all..."
"Sh-Shindo...?"{p}

At that instant, Shindo appeared right in front of me, holding a box cutter.
"Sorry about this.
That guy I killed in my dream? He looked exactly like me.
That dream was the devil inside Makoto Shindo killing the human being called Makoto Shindo.
Shindo tried his damnedest to let at least the one he liked escape, but I've eaten every last bit of his soul.
Ha ha ha...
Scared of the devil?
There's a devil inside you too, you know.
It's itching to take your place.
...Here's a present from the devil.
Have fun with Shindo in the next world."
Shindo... no, the devil raised his arm.

And the next instant, a blade gleaming silver was buried deep in my chest.
A shuddering chill ran through me, and the knife was pulled out.{p}

...And then bright red blood sprayed out after it like a fountain.
In my vision, dyed redder and redder...
Two devils were laughing......{p}

"...I see."
There was clear disappointment in Shindo's voice as he murmured that.
Was he really that shocked that I said I couldn't believe him?
If so, I'd done something awful.
"Can't believe me, huh......"
Adding only that, in an even more dejected voice, Shindo fell completely silent.
"Um...
Shindo...?"
Unable to bear it, I called out into the darkness.

Then, from deep in the darkness, came a thud, like something falling over.
"Shindo...★"
"Can't... be... lieve..."
What faintly reached my ears was a hoarse voice, broken and halting.
And then...
"Kyahahahaha......"
...a woman's shrill, piercing laughter.
Whose voice is this...?
"{b}, so you say you can't believe it?"
This voice is...
"...Fukuzawa★"
"Ding-dong!
That's exactly right, congratulaaaations!"{p}
The moment Fukuzawa's bright voice rang out, the lights in the room snapped on.{p}

"Eek...☆"
I looked around and caught my breath.
It was the newspaper club room.
But not the club room I knew.
The walls, the floor, even the ceiling were stained red with blood, and corpses lay everywhere.
It was everyone who'd gathered for the seven wonders.
Arai, Kazama, Hosoda, and Iwashita...
And Shindo......
Every one of them had died with a look of agony still on their face.
And standing there, as if looking down on all their corpses, was Fukuzawa, soaked in red.{p}

"Hey, {b}.
Everything Shindo told you is true, every last bit of it.
That man killed my other half.
The half of me that lived inside dreams...
My other half was a boy, and he loved going on adventures through people's dreams.
But when he wandered into Shindo's dream, he got trapped in the school that appeared in it......
You heard the rest in the story, right?
He couldn't do a thing, and he got killed without putting up any fight at all.
The pain of losing your other half, you know, it's truly agonizing.
It feels like your body is being torn apart, and afterward you can't stop shaking.
Your strength and your will both drain away, and whatever you do, you get tired right away.
No matter how much you sleep, all that spreads before your eyes is pitch-black darkness.
And only the pain my other half suffered comes back to me.
It's the kind of pain that comes crying 'It hurts, it hurts so much' all the way up from the depths of hell.{p}

...Oh, but maybe telling you all this was pointless?
I mean, {b},
you said you couldn't believe it, didn't you?
...Well then, it can't be helped.
You'll just have to experience it for yourself, {b}."
With that, Fukuzawa twisted the corner of her mouth into a smile.
"{b}...
This is a present from me.
Enjoy every terrifying moment of it.
And then write a wonderful article, okay?"
As I stared at Fukuzawa's eerie smile, my consciousness slipped away.{p}
...And then, I had a dream.{p}

Two girls in the school's back courtyard...
One was swinging a box cutter, and every time her arm swept wide, the other girl's body was stained with more blood.
...Stop it!
My scream made no sound.
The defenseless girl grew bloodier and bloodier.
...Stop it, stop it☆
Even so, I kept on screaming.
And finally...
"Stooooop!☆"
The moment my voice became sound for the first time...{p}
I woke up with a start.

...It was a dream.
What a vivid dream...
When I cried out in the dream...
the two girls both looked at me at the same moment.

Their faces...
Both of them had my face!
The girl gripping the knife...
and the girl covered in blood...
both of them were me★{p}
Startled by my own voice, I woke up with a start.

...It was a dream.
But...
I can't tell anymore where the dreaming begins and ends.
Maybe even this very moment, when I think I'm awake, is a dream too.{p}

"Don't say that. Just hear me out.
...Okay?"{p}

"But, Shindo...
It's dangerous to go alone.
Let's escape together."
"No, I can't do that.
If we stick together, we'll just make ourselves easier targets.
Besides, if the others are lost somewhere, we'll find them easier if we split up."
"But..."
"Aw, don't worry.
I'll see you at the school gate."
"O-okay..."{p}

All right!
I'll try the fire escape!
...That's what I thought, but...
What the heck, it's locked!
Useless right when I need it most...
Oh, well...{p}

I'll go to the front entrance like always.
From there I can get out to the schoolyard and run for the school gate.{p}

What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...{p}
............Oh! This is no time to be hesitating.
Go to the front entrance
Use the fire escape
...Fearfully, I opened my eyes, and...?{p}

Before my eyes was a familiar, friendly smile!
"K-Kazama...★"
"Well, hey, that was a close call.
Missing a step on the stairs... You're more of a cute little klutz than I thought."
Kazama was holding me in his arms like a princess, beaming.
...Did he save me?
But wait a minute...
I didn't miss a step.
Someone pushed me from behind.
Was this the work of 'that one' Shindo told me about...?
Yes...
It had to be.{p}

Oh no!
This is no time to be standing around in a daze.
I have to get away, fast...!
"Kazama...
Um, thank you for saving me.
I'm okay now, so please put me down."{p}

"Why's that?"
"Why?
Because we have to get out of here, fast!"
"Get out...?{p}

Never mind that, let's go on a date, you and me.
I think that'd be a much more meaningful way for you to spend your time, too."
...Why does this guy always have to go at his own pace like this?
We're in no position to be doing anything like that right now...
"Kazama...
We're in really serious dan......"{p}

"Stop!
{b}, you don't have to say another word.
You're going to say we're in danger, right?
I know that much perfectly well.{p}

Don't worry, you're safe with me.
After all, I'm a little different from ordinary humans, you know."
...I was left kind of dumbfounded.
Nozomu Kazama......
Maybe he really is something amazing, in more ways than one.
It's true, with him around I get the feeling that curses and grudges wouldn't work at all.{p}And it doesn't look like 'that one' is after him, either, so maybe I'd be safer with him than alone...?
Go on a date with Kazama
Just get away
What should I do...

"...Hm?
What is it?
Have you decided you want to go on a date with me?"{p}Ugh, something about this guy's smile is kind of scary.
Is it really safe to just answer honestly?
Say you want to go on a date
Say you don't want any date
What should I do...

"No.
I don't want to go on any date."
This really isn't the time for that.
Besides...
With a guy like this, you have to turn him down flat.{p}

"Well, well...
You really are a stubborn one, aren't you?{p}

But I like that stubborn side of you."
...Even turning him down flat didn't work, apparently.
"Oh, well, it can't be helped.
In that case, I'll see you home.
Where, you ask...?
Why, to your house, of course.
You'd feel safer that way too, wouldn't you?
Heh heh heh heh......"
Sh-should I be happy about this?
I'm not so sure, but at least he's trying to get out of the school, right?
Then I guess it's okay...
"Heh heh heh...
Well then, {b},
shall we go home?"
Kazama smiled brightly and started walking, still carrying me in his arms.
"Wa...
Wait, Kazama...★"{p}"Never mind, never mind.
This is how lovers in love go home, you know."
We are not lovers!
...Oh, do whatever you want!

"...Oh, do whatever you want!"
"Okay!"
Kazama answered happily and went bounding down the stairs.
...I-is this okay?
Isn't this dangerous......?
...Just as I thought that.{p}

Helpless, my body was flung into the air along with Kazama.
What a day for falling...
For an instant, that was what went through my mind.
A dull impact came right after...

............Huh?
It doesn't hurt that much...
Why...?
Now that I think about it, the floor feels strangely soft.
And kind of slimy, too...{p}
